notes: Reached via Claude-in-Chrome only. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (generic Shopify robots.txt, Allow: / for all agents). Site is Shopify. Category tree built from the full mega-menu (read via read_page accessibility tree on the header nav, which exposed all department > sub-department > leaf links including the 'Go to X' parent links), then cross-checked against /sitemap_collections_1.xml (636 collection URLs) per the mandatory sitemap trap. The sitemap check surfaced ~150 additional furniture-keyword collection handles not in the mega-menu; each was probed via same-origin fetch to /collections/<handle>/products.json. Nearly all were either (a) 0 products (orphaned/abandoned Shopify collections, e.g. outdoor-furniture, garden-furniture, garden-sofas, garden-swings, benches, curio-cabinet, sliding-door-wardrobe, wall-shelve, all-shelves -- none of these are linked from any live nav and none have products, so the site genuinely has no Outdoor/Garden furniture department despite the handle existing), or (b) marketing/sale/bundle/brand-line rollups (best-deal-*, big-sale-*, *-offers, *-fest, *-package-*, arias-*, haptik-*, earthblend-*, serenity-boldscape-*, midnight-mirage-*, dining-room, dining-dining, dining-kitchen -- cross-department or promo collections), or (c) tiny (1-3 product) legacy tag-collections that duplicate products already counted under a nav-visible node (bar-stools/bar-cabinet/bar-furniture-accessories overlap Bar Furniture; sideboard-cabinets/wooden-cabinets/overhead-cabinet overlap Cabinets; stool/console overlap other leaves; shoe-rack-open/closed/semi-open overlap Shoe Racks; solid-wood-beds/metal-beds/engineered-wood-beds/hydraulic-storage-beds/modular-beds-new/upholstered-modular-beds are material/type filters of Beds). None of these orphaned or overlapping handles are reachable from any navigation, breadcrumb, or category page on the live site, so they were excluded to avoid double-counting products already captured under the real taxonomy nodes below. Two pages under mega-menu items are /pages/ marketing pages, not collections, and were skipped: Infinia Modular Sofa, Modular Beds, Modular Dining. 'Ladders' (Living Room > Home Office branch) excluded as a household tool, not furniture. 'Coat Hangers' kept as furniture -- verified by title (Paul/Polar/Oscar Coat Hanger) these are freestanding wooden coat-hanger stands, not wall hooks. 'Chest of Drawers' (/collections/chest-of-drawers) appears identically in both the Living Room and Bedroom mega-menu branches; emitted once (under Living Room) to avoid a duplicate-link row, per the no-duplicate-rows rule. Mattress is a separate domain (nilkamalsleep.com) and out of scope per brief. Qty method: same-origin fetch() of /collections/<handle>/products.json paginated with limit=250 to an empty page, counting unique product ids (method matches what the prior Home-Decor pass for this exact company used and found reliable -- this is the store's own catalogue feed, not the unreliable Shopify products_count field). Corroborated once against the rendered storefront: /collections/sofa-set showed '80 products' in the visible UI, exactly matching the products.json enumeration (80) -- method confirmed exact, not padded. No categories read 0 products on any nav-reachable leaf. No stock-gating or count-drift observed on the two categories spot-checked.
